description: This Java class 'CommandAndControlClient' is a Spring component that serves as an AMQP client for Eclipse Hono's Command and Control APIs. It manages connections, messaging, and command receipt over AMQP, specifically using Vert.x Proton library, to handle control commands and send responses within an IoT or messaging framework.

classes.name: CommandAndControlClient
classes.description: A Spring component class that implements an AMQP client for handling command and control messages via Eclipse Hono's APIs using Vert.x Proton library.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the command receiver, sets up message handling for incoming commands, and sends responses or logs received messages.

methods.name: startCommandReceiver
methods.description: Establishes an AMQP connection and creates a receiver link for receiving commands using the provided message handler.

methods.name: subscribeToCommands
methods.description: Configures and opens a receiver link to receive commands from the designated command endpoint.
